title: Heated Pool + Hot Tub + Game Room + Water Slide
description:
Welcome to this Arizona paradise! Find everything you would want for your stay here, including a backyard set up for entertaining. Here you'll find a stunning pool with a built into the ground bbq grill, add some loungers and your ready to relax! Oh did we mention the wrap around misters to cool off on a sunny day. 
Move inside to watch some tv, play games, or challenge someone to pool. 
Whatever your reason for coming, we're sure that you'll find a great time and leave with some new memories!

 Other things to note 
TPT License # 21633030
City License # 303623
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year
Standalone high chair - always at the listing

house_rules.quiet_hours:
Additional rules: This is a NON-SMOKING property: This includes - Cigarettes, Cigars, Juuls, E-cigs, Marijuana, etc. No smoking allowed anywhere on the property, including  inside the home, the garage, the backyard, or the front yard. Any violation of smoking on the property will result in $1000 charge to your airbnb account. 

10PM-8AM neighborhood quiet hours.

5 car limit parked at the house. Please use the garage and driveway to park your cars, avoid any parking on the street. Do not park in front of the neighbor's homes or in front of the fire-hydrant in the cul-de-sac.

No events/large parties at the home. This includes corporate gatherings, wedding ceremonies and/or bachelor/bachelorette events, fraternity parties, etc. 

Violation Fees - AIRBNB IS AUTHORIZED TO CHARGE THESE FEES ON YOUR ACCOUNT IF VIOLATED

Un-authorized party or gathering: $500.00
Smoking Fee: $1000.00
Noise complaint: $100 
Late Checkout Fee: $50.00 per 30 minutes after checkout time

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about the house rules.
